experiment: corrected-dataset-fix (SMF3: single-objective training on corrected data)
description: Trains RNN/LSTM/Transformer/Mamba on the corrected stack-manipulation training set (languages/stack-manipulation-fixed) under the 'rec+ns' objective, 10 trials each (40 runs). Per-trial hyperparameter sampling matches train_and_evaluate.bash exactly. Evaluated on both the standard FLaRe test set and the corrected test set.
